verdict.rationale: Quantization is a fair axis for a local LLM runtime like llamafile, but the evidence pack never mentions quantization, bit-widths, or memory-footprint reduction. The only related item states that llamafile supports GGUF models (llamafile-docs-17). Inferring quantization levels from that requires outside knowledge the pack does not supply, so the documented low-bit to 8-bit range is unevidenced.
